name: Guardian I
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level druid 1

DESCRIPTION

As mount, but the caster summons a CR 1 animal (same as the spell’s level).

The same rules can be used to create Guardian II – Guardian IX (summoning CR 2 through CR 9 animals).
